tei:div.tei:p: 279) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: ḍā ki mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: 280) (Dakini secret letter here) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

sku gsung thugs ldan 'gro ba'i mgon: sgrib pa kun spangs ye shes sku: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin brnyes: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'-i dus: nga yi rjes 'jug brgyud 'dzin rnams: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa'i phyir: kho mo nga yi thugs kyi bcud: sgrub pa dngos grub snye ma mchog: rang gi sgrub par rang gis brtsams: rjes 'jug bu yi dpal du bkod: tshul bzhin nyams su len pa gnad: sa ma ya: lag tu len pa'i rim pa ni: dben zhing nyams dga' 'tshe bral ba: sngon byon grub brnyes zhabs bcags pa'i: gnas sam dben phrod gangs khrod dam: yang na byin chags skyed tshal du: 281) gnas gzhi'i sta gon skabs dang bstun: mkha' 'gro'i dus ston dbang gi dus: tsha gsum bsil gsum bcud kyis bsgyur: gnas khang phyi nang yul phyogs kun: bcud kyis bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs: gsang rdzas gsum mam bzhi yis bdug: nyes skyon dri ma dag par byas: mkho ba'i yo byad rab 'bring tha: rnal 'byor rang gi nyams dang sbyar: bde ba'i stan la 'khod par bya: sa ma ya: gang zag blo rim dang mthun pa'i: sgrub pa nyams su len pa ni: rab ni rtogs pa klong gyur 282) pa'i: skyes bu rig pa'i blo can gyi: spyod yul gdams pa 'di kho na: snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor la: stong nyid shes rab btsun mo'i mkhar: 'khor 'das chos kun ye rdzogs che: lhun grub bde ba chen po'i dbyings: sku dang ye shes yon tan kun: mnyam nyid ye rdzogs chen po ni: sgrub dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gzhir: mngon gyur gdingathob gnad rtogs pa: kho mo mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub yin: dbang po yul gyi blo can la: rdzas dang brda don gnyis la brten: rdzas ni ma dā bdud rtsis bsgyur: gsang rdzas gnyis kyi nus pa bskyed: brda don tshul ldan rdor dril dang: rdo rje sems dpa'i me long ngam: yang na rin chen a rar+sha: thabs kyis sgyur nas chos 'byung bris:

dbus su bam̐ dang ra bzhi la: phyogs dang mthun pa'i 'bru bzhi ni: dbu can 'phrul yig ltar bkod bya: gsang mchod dkar dmar ro bcud rdzas: legs par bshams nas nus ldan bsgrub: rang nyid bde ba'i mal du 'khod: lha dang snang ba chos nyid gsum: ye rdzogs chen po'i dgongs par bsre: dran bsam spros pa kun spangs te: gnas lugs lhum zhugs dgongs pa'i ngang: ye shes rlung gis nus bcud bskul: sbyor ba bzhi ldan gnad zab chos: rtsa sngags dang ni rdor bzlas bya: mtshan nyid gsum ldan rlung la brtson: dus dang 283) bstun nas kha dog dang: khams kyi bye brag khyad par gyi: khams dang grogs 'phrad mthun par bsgom: skabs skabs yas mas thabs shes bskul: rlung gnad bde bar sbyor shes gnad: de ni gsung gi sgrub pa'o: spros pa rtsol bcas blo rim la: sbyor dngos rjes kyi tshul du bstan: dang po sngon 'gro'i sta gon la: gnas gzhi la sogs spyi ltar bya: brten pa rab ni rdul tshon dang: 'bring ni ras bris tha ma yang: rin chen mañdza skyon bral la: dri ldan spos chus legs sbyar te: snying po'i tshom bu lha grangs dang: rtsa gsum nor lha srung ma yi: gtor ma dang ni sgrub rten dang: gsang rten mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo'am: srog 'khor sku brnyan la sogs bshams: mtshan ldan bhan+dha bcud kyis gtams: bum pa me long 'ja' shel dang: gsang sman dag gi ril bu sogs: mkho ba'i yo byad sta gon bsags: gnas gzhis phyi nang gong bzhin brlabs: mchod pa'i yo byad grogs la sogs: sel med grong pa'i skyon can spongs: gzhung bzhin tshul dang ldan pa gnad: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: bde ba'i ldan la bag phab nas: nub kyi phyogs su kha gyur la: bskyed sbyang smin pa'i man ngag mthar: mdun mkhar tshogs zhing gsal btab nas: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: 284)na mo: skye med ye shes kun bzang mo: 'gags med rde rje rnal 'byor ma:

thugs rje sprul sku mtsho rgyal mar: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: lan gsum brjod nas sems bskyed ni: hoḥ mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: rnam grol sa la 'god pa'i phyir: bdag gis rim gnyis lam bsgom nas: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang sems bskyed: lan gsum brjod nas tshogs bsags ni: na mo: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag lus rdul snyed grangs sprul nas: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: lus dang longs spyod bsod nams dge: chags zhen med par mchod pa 'bul: thog med nas bsags nyes tshogs kun: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis bshags: bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa yi: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul phyir: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: khams gsum 'khor ba ma stong bar: rgyal kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: kun kyang srid las rnam grol te: gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: ces brjod tshogs zhing rang la bsdu: bgegs 'dul khro 285) bo rta mgrin bsgom: de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni rig pa don gyi lha: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gshed du che: gsang chen mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sgrub la mi dbang bar chad bgegs: 'dod yon gtor ma 'di longs la: so so rang rang gnas su song: gal te mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: lus ngag rdul du brlag ta re: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ pad+ma kro ta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs nas drag sngags kyis bkrad: de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i rtsal: 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang: pad+ma rgya gram me rlung chu'i: srung ba'i 'khor lor lhun gyis grub: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur du gyur: oṃ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: ram̐ rak+ṣa:

yam̐ rak+ṣa: kham̐ rak+ṣa: rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni: hoḥ rang rig sku gsum lhun grub dpal: ma bcos ngang gnas chen por rdzogs: rang byung ye shes gsal ba'i sgo: ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa dbye: dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: 286)ma bcos ngang nas rang shar ba'i: rang byung ye shes chen po'i rtsal: bde chen mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha: rang ngo rang zhal mjal phyag 'tshal: na mo dzñā na na ma hoḥ de nas byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: chos sku dbyings kyi yum chen mo: kun tu bzang mos byin chen phobs: byin chen ngo mtshar= nges pa lnga ldan pho brang nas: longs sku rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rdo rje phag mos byin chen= byin chen= mi mjed sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: dbu skra thor cog ldems se sdem: zar bu 'phyang phrul ta la la: rin chen rgyan cha si li li: rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo lo: dar dpyangs mang po pu ru ru: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad sangs se sang: dpa' bos bro brdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li liḥ byin rlabs na bun thibs se thib: dbang byin dngos grub ta la la: gnas 287)mchog 'di ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog sgo gsum rdo rjer rlobs: gnas dang sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad: zhing dang gzhal yas lha'i rnam rol: yongs grub chen por byin gyis rlobs: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog thun bde ba'i dngos grub stsol: pad+ma dzñā na ḍā ki ni sa ra dza ya hring hring badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ dza dzaḥ de nas mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun:

ye nas bde chen dag pa'i rdzas: bla med gsang ba'i mchod chen po: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du sprul: rab 'byams zhing kun yongs khyab gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shap+da sogs: spar+she āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bā liṃ ta rak+ta sarba ta na ga ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor 'jug bshags ni: hoḥ rang rig sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i dal: ma rig gnyis 'dzin sbun pas bsgribs: gzhan bzung 'khor ba'i bag chags kun: dag chen chos dbyings klong du bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ 288) de nas rang dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang: rang byung ye shes byang chub sems: dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bo ru: mngon gyur chen por dam bca' 'o: hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta āḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed pa ni: āḥ 'khor 'das chos rnams gdod ma nas: brjod bral stong pa de bzhin nyid: rang gsal 'dzin med chen po'i ngang: kun snang 'gro la khyab par brdal: thugs rje'i ye shes chen po'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ger shar: 'phro 'dus 'od kyis dwangs bcud bsdus: yongs gyur snang ba stong chen mkhar: phyi snod bde chen mkha' spyaud zhing: nang bcud dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal: de dbus lhun grub gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid bkod pa rab rdzogs klong: skyon bral pad zla nyi ma dang: bde chen chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus: dbyings nas sa bon gdan la babs: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal mchog: rje mo ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhal gcig pa: spyan gsum sku gsum dbyings su gzigs: zhi 'dzum 289)mtshan dpe'i lang tsho ldan: phyag gnyis g.yas pas cang te'u dkrol: g.yon pas rin chen dril bu 'dzin: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs su bzhengs: nu 'bur gsang ba'i pad+ma rgyas:

dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings: lhag ma zar bu sku rgyab 'phyang: rin po che yi rtse bran mdzes: dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: ut+pal dmar po'i do shal dang: rin chen sna tshogs snyan mgul brgyan: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: ye shes 'ja' sku stong gsal gyi: gnas lnga rtsa yi 'khor lo ru: gu ru thod phreng lde lnga ni: dkar dmar mthing ser ljang 'od 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: rang rtags rigs lnga'i phyag rgya 'dzin: g.yon rnams bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu 'od phung ldan: rang snang yum dang gnyis med 'khril: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: mtsho skyes rdo rje dmar gsal mdzes: zhi ma khro 'dzum nyams dang ldan: zhal gcig phyag 290)gnyis g.yas pa yis: gser gyi rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag thod bum 'dzin: dbu skra thod bcings zar bu khrol: thod skam dbu brgyan rtse bran mdzes: stag sham rus pa'i rgyan drug dang: dar sna'i cod pan dar dpyangs spras: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis ni: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: sku la bde chen gsang ba'i yum: man+dha ra ba 'khril sbyor rol: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong dkyil du: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: phyi rim chos 'byung dga' 'khyil dbus: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: rang sprul rigs lnga'i ḍā ki ma: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdzes: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis cang te'u dril bu 'khrol: spyan gnyis gdul bya'i yul la gzigs: dbu skra thod bcings lhag ma sil: dar dpyangs rin chen rgyan drug gsol: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: rang rtsal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍā kis bskor: phyi rim pad+ma zla gdan la: phrin las bzhi yi phyag rgya mo:

dkar ser dmar ljang zhi 291)ma khro: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: g.yon rnams thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: sku la dar dang rin chen brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad zlar bzhugs: las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med sgrub: de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs kyi: spyi bor oṃ dang mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas kun: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnam pa ru: spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas nas: skye med chos sku'i mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub gzhal yas nas: 'gags med longs sku'i mkha' 'gro gshegs= thugs rje gang 'dul sprul pa'i gnas mchog nas: phyogs med sprul sku'i mkha' 'gro= rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: rigs bdag mtsho skyes rdo rje gshegs= rig stong bde chen dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: gu ru thod phreng sde lnga= mkha' spyod dhu ma tha la'i gnas mchog nas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal= bkod pa 292) rab rdzogs lhun grub gzhal yas nas: rigs lnga dbyings kyi ḍā ki= rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gzhal yas nas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro= tshad med bzhi yi phrin las phyag rgya mo: sgo skyong ḍā ki sde bzhi= gzhan yang gnas yul dur khrod la sogs pa: rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi: mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs: zhing skyong dam can ḍā ki bstan srung sde: ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sgrub mchog sgo gsum rdo rjair byin gyis rlobs: bskyed rim rnam dag dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: rdzogs rim phyi nang gzhan gsum sku gsum klong: ye gdangs lhun grub rig pa sku ru smin: mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol: rnal 'byor tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa dang:

mchog thun su kha'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya ha ri ni sa sarba hriṃ hriṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin ngang la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang: thugs rje'i thabs mkhas gang 'dul skur sprul pa: ye shes sgyu 'phrul mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: gnyis med 293)bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid du: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig brtan bzhugs gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: rang rig bde chen byang chub sems: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas che: lhan skyes ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal: mngon gyur rig pas ye phyag 'tshal: na mo a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas phyi mchod ni: oṃ: mchod pa'i phyag rgya rnam dag pa: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri mchog bdug spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal sgron me spyan la 'bul: dri zhim spos chu sku la 'bul: ro ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul: snyan pa'i rol mo snyan la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra puṣ+pe

sogs: shap+da pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: de nas nang mchod ni: āḥ mchod pa'i phyag rgya rnam dag 294)pa: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: ting 'dzin las sprul lha mo yis: gar stabs 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur gyi: yid 'ong mdzes ldan gzugs mchog dang: snyan dbyangs pi waṃ gling bu'i sgra: dri zhim dri mchog bsung ngad ldan: sna tshogs brgyad ldan ro mchog zas: srab 'jam rab mdzes reg bya dang: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra rū pa shap+da= dharma pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: de nas gsang mchod ni: hūm̐: mchod pa'i phyag rgya rnam dag pa: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dang: brtan g.yo'i bcud dril bha liṃ ta: dug gsum dbyings bsgrol rak+ta'i mtsho: snang stong gnyis med sbyor mchod dang: khams gsum sku gsum dbyings bsgral ba'i: rmad byung gsang ba'i mchod chen po: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba 295)ma hā dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta bha liṃ ta rak+ta sarba ta na ga ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i dbyings su bde chen kun bzang mo: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rdo rje phag mo'i sku: mi mjed zhing 'dir sprul sku mtsho rgyal ma: sku gsum yongs 'dus ḍā ki'i rje mor bstod: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rab mdzes gzhon nu'i sku: mnyan lcugs 'khril ldem gsal 'tsher lhun stug cing: sna tshogs rgyan ldan gzi brjid 'od phung 'bar: sku yi yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs gsang nyag gcig spros pa bral ba'i dbyings: chos rnams ma lus mnyam pa nyid du chub:

lhun grub sku dang ye shes bdag nyid dpal: thugs kyi yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: yid 'ong mgrin pa'i ldeb phreng legs 'ong ldan: gsung gsang yan lag drug bcu'i dbyangs snyan gyis: zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi mdzod 'chang ba: gsung gi yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam thar gsum ldan shes rab pha rol phyin: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug thugs rje'i gar: dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gsang 296)chen mo: yon tan yongs rdzogs dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gdod nas ye sangs rgyas kyang gdul bya'i ngor: thugs rje thabs mkhas bstan 'gro bde la bkod: sna tshogs sprul pas gsang sngags chos sgo 'byed: phrin las bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang gi sku: gsung ni mi 'gags rang byung brda yi gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo brjod bral chos sku'i thugs: sku gsung thugs ldan rigs kyi bdag por bstod: gzhan yang rang snang lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: ye shes rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul lhar shar ba: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag ḍā ki'i tshogs: las mdzad sgo skyong dam can rgya mtsho dang: ging chen dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor dang bcas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas: mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal zhing nyams: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs sor chud dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs tshang bar brjod: de nas 'dzab dmigs ni: hūm̐: rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gror gsal ba yi: sku dbus dwangs gsal thugs klong 'od lnga'i sbubs: phag mo dmar gsal gar stabs gri thod 297)'dzin: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang: thugs srog bam̐ yig dkar gsal 'od du 'bar: mtha' mar bzlas sngags mgal me g.yon du 'khor: de las 'od 'phros rigs bdag thugs rgyud bskul: sku gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dbang dngos grub:

bsdus te srog gi snying por ro gcig 'dres: sgo gsum sgrib dag dkyil 'khor gsum du 'phos: gsal stong mnyam gnas bde ba chen po'i ngang: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas sgrub 'dzab ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal rnams kyi: rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus dang: dbang byin dngos grub nus stobs gzi brjid dpal: lnga ldan 'od kyi rnam par rang la thim: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du dag mnyam rol: khams gsum sku gsung thugs su mnyam sbyor bas: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: dag par rab 'byams bde ba chen po'i klong: gtso 'khor snying po srog sngags ro gcig gyur: bzlas pa'i sngags sgras sa gsum g.yo bar bsgoms: 298)oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas las la sbyor ba ni: hūm̐: rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin rlabs nus pa bsdus: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub ma lus thob: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon bag chags sbyangs: brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dpal yon tshe bsod bsdus: slar yang 'od dang 'od zer rab 'phros pas: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rab 'byams: sgrub cing dngos grub ma lus kun thob dmigs: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya bam̐ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya dzaḥking ka ra sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar gsal ngar ldan pa'i ngang: snyen pa 'bum phrag bco brgyad dang: sgrub pa'ang de nyid dpog par bya: las sbyor tshad ni de'i phyed cha: bzla tshe skyon gsum dri ma spongs: gsal dag brtan gsum ldan pa'i ngang: tshul bzhin nyams su len gyur na: bskyed rdzogs rnam grangs mang mi dgos: 'di nyid gcig pus sgrub 'bras thob: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin lam:

tshe 'dir thob par the tshom med: sa ma ya: rtags kyi rim 299) pa bsam yas kyang: mchog tu lhan skyes ye shes kyi: chos sku'i rang zhal mngon gyur nas: bsgom byung shes rab rtsal 'bar te: snang srid brda dang gdams par shar: thun mong mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang: nyams dga' bag phebs lha zhal mthong: 'bras ldan ljon pa'i tshal dang ni: khrus kyi rdzing bur zhugs pa dang: shel dang rin chen rigs byed rnyed: bhan+dhar 'dud rtsi 'thung ba dang: mdzes ldan mda' dar mthong ba sogs: mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags su bshad: phrin las kha bsgyur gab yig ltar: tshul bzhin gnad ldan nyams blangs na: gang 'dod dngos grub 'bad med thob: the tshom med do sa ma ya: e ma: shin tu gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: yang zab mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di: dpal dbyangs dang ni zhi ba mtsho la gdams: lho rgyud gsang phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong gi: nor bu g.yu mtshor rin chen gter du sbos: da dung ma spel mi 'gyur dgongs rgyas thob: ma 'ongs snyigs dus nyi shu kha ral tshe: mi rnams log pa bdud kyi 'bangs su gyur: mtha' mi dbus rdib bod khams phung ba'i tshe: dkon mchog gsum la log par lta ba dang: dge bcu dor zhing mi dge sna tshogs gsog: mdo sngags chos gnyis me chu 'phrad bzhin smod: dge ba'i bshes dang dge grogs dgra ltar mthong: sngags 300) pas dam mi bsrung zhing mgo reg byed: bskyed rdzogs gding bral yul kun dal med nyul: log 'tsho'i zas spyod lkog tu bud med 'chang: btsun pas 'dul khrims nyams nas skya chas byed: chos brgyad mdun bsu dkar po'i dge chos bor: mi rnams kun kyang shes rgyud rgya 'dres brloms: rang gzhan phung byed mi dge sna tshogs bsags: nang 'khrugs 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo: chos sgrub smad cing bdud sprul skyabs su brten: cha lugs ma nges dus ngan rang rtags ngoms: chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar tsam 'byung:

spyod ngan rang gis bsgrub cing dus ngan zer: dus rnam mi 'gyur mi rnams 'gyur ba'i tshe: bod 'bangs mtsho rgyal bdag gis ma skyob na: bod 'di seng khog srin bus g.yeng skang mtshungs: de phyir kho mo'i thugs sgrub snying po 'di: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med thugs kyi ming: dman pa'i tshul 'dzin dbang rigs byang sems ldan: der 'phrad yul gsum bstan pa'i sgron me gsal: a tsar+ya dang dpal dbyangs zung ldan sprul: mi 'gyur rdo rjes gsang ba'i gter sgo 'byed: chos kyi bdag po dharma kit+ti dang: bir+ya badz+ra pra ba ma ti shrī: shi tra dzñā na dza ya karma sogs: rim 'phrad chos 'di shar dang lho nas dar: du ru ka yi bstan pa re zhig nyams: gter gnyis 'phrad pas 301) rgya bod mun pa sel: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung mched gsum gnod sbyin tshogs la gtad: dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs: gter bdag ḍā ki'i tshogs kyis gnyer mdzod cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rdo rje'i zhal lung du mar grogs su bsngags pa sprul pa'i gter chen rin po che gsang bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhal snga nas dri bral ka shi'i mdangs 'dzin gyi lha reg srid du ring ba dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos rdzas du ma dang bcas bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa ldog tu ma nus par kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
